title: See progress on the slides
statement: As a developer, I can see on a Plan's slides which Tasks they reference and which of those are done, so the deck itself tells me how far the work has come.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan slide can reference Tasks, and the reader shows which ones with a link to each.
A referenced Task's done state shows on the slide.
Marking a Task done changes what its slides show without anyone republishing those slides.
